His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

translations.web: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
translations.bsb: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
translations.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
translations.asv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
